text: not working for me. Not impressed, I had charcoal odor absorbers before (different brand) and they worked fabulous in the same space. This one doesn't do much at all, pretty disappointed. Not sure as to why, the size is big enough for the room?

product_metadata.title: Phaii Bamboo Activated Charcoal Odor Absorber & Deodorizer - Natural Odor Removal & Eliminates Moisture for Shoe, Bag, Closet, Equipment Sport | Fragrance Free - Easy Portable (180g)
features: ELIMINATES ODORS AND PURIFIES YOUR SURROUNDINGS: Get rid of unpleasant, putrid smells and noxious odors by purchasing Phai’s Activated Charcoal Odor Absorber. You will be finally able to move from one room to another and enjoy the pleasant, refreshing air wafting through your home – without nasty olfactory shocks!

100% ACTIVE BAMBOO CHARCOAL: This natural fiber produces the most effective form of active charcoal. Our odor absorber is made using high quality bamboo charcoal, which was burnt under a temperature of more than 1000 degrees Celsius, ensuring maximum odor absorbing efficiency.

WICKS AWAY MOISTURE: The number one factor promoting the growth harmful microorganisms and spread of foul odors within your home is moisture. Free your living space from excess moisture with this premium bamboo absorber and enjoy a healthy, fresh atmosphere within your home!
ODOR ABSORBER: Our unique, natural product is here to help you sanitize your home. Our bamboo absorber also removes any volatile chemicals from whichever space it’s placed in.

A VERSATILE: Think further than your closet, cupboard drawers, fridge, bathroom and shoes. You can use Phaii in your car, your sports locker or bag and in your pet’s living quarters! There’s no place that won’t benefit from Phaii!
